$comment: One-way sync: hub (AgentArmy) -> spoke repos. Hub is the source of truth for the Claude Code microVM helper surface. Edit `spokes` to add a repo. Edit `paths` to change what syncs. `deny` is a hard safety net enforced even if a path is added by mistake.
$ownership_note: templates/arcadedb-image (and future templates/*-image/ platform images: fuseki, event-bridge, …) are intentionally NOT synced — they're hub-owned platform infra per ARC-ADR-023. Spokes consume the running instances via env (ARCADEDB_URL, NATS_URL, …), not by vendoring the Dockerfile.
